Name: EnergyProtect
Author: a188616786a
Description:
With this mod, you cannot use tools without enough stamina. Instead, there will be a "X" emote on top of the character, and the energy rect will shake.

support tools: FishingRod, Axe, Hoe, Pickaxe, WateringCan, MilkPail, Shears.
